steps.smsTitle: Get your ticket number by text message
steps.smsText: That is all: your online purchase is done. A ticket bought here does not need to be printed. Just keep the ticket number that was sent to you by text message.
steps.seatText: Buying online lets you pick your own seat. Look at the seat map of the bus, choose the seat you like and enjoy your trip.
steps.busTitle: Choose the ticket that suits you
steps.busText: Tickets from the bus companies are shown with price, departure time, terminal and bus type, so you can choose the one that suits you.
steps.routeText: Buying a bus ticket on Rahi is simple and needs no sign-up. Enter the origin and destination to see the best, most trusted and cheapest bus tickets.

info.printText: Enter the ticket number that was sent to you by text message to print or view your ticket at any time.
info.trackText: Did your ticket number not arrive, or have you forgotten it? Do not worry. This section is for finding it again.
info.refundText: Want to cancel your ticket? Have your plans changed? Just follow the refund steps. It is a simple process.

faq.heading: Bus tickets: frequently asked questions
faq.extraCostQuestion: Does buying a bus ticket on Rahi cost extra?
faq.extraCostAnswer: No. Buying on Rahi adds no extra cost for the passenger: the online price is the same as the price at the terminal. Buying online also lets you see discounted tickets on different routes and buy at the best price.
faq.pricesQuestion: Does Rahi set the ticket prices?
faq.pricesAnswer: No. Rahi has no part in setting ticket prices. All prices are set by the bus companies and shown to passengers on the Rahi website.
faq.vipQuestion: What is the difference between a VIP and a regular bus ticket?
faq.vipAnswer: A VIP ticket is for a bus with fewer seats, seats that recline further, and extras such as a charger and a seat-back screen. Travelling on a VIP bus is more comfortable, and a VIP ticket costs more.
faq.childrenQuestion: Do children under 2 need a ticket?
faq.childrenAnswer: Yes. Everyone who sits in a seat of their own needs a ticket, so a seat must be booked for them. This also applies to online booking.
faq.petsQuestion: Can I take a pet on the bus?
faq.petsAnswer: Carrying animals on intercity buses is against road transport rules.
faq.cancelQuestion: Can a bus ticket be cancelled online?
faq.cancelAnswer: If the ticket was bought online on Rahi, it can be cancelled online. Go to the refund section and enter the 12-digit ticket number. A ticket bought at a terminal or on another website cannot be cancelled on Rahi.
faq.printQuestion: Do I need to print my ticket after buying online?
faq.printAnswer: No. The ticket number sent to you by text message is enough for your trip.

trust.text: Rahi lists a wide range of trips and lets you buy bus tickets from bus companies and cooperatives right away, with no need to sign up. Seeing the bus type and its photos, and choosing the seat you want, lets you plan a trip to anywhere in the country with confidence.
trust.supportText: Do not worry about any problem. Whether it is the departure time, a text message that did not arrive or anything else, our support team is ready to help you by phone or online.
trust.companiesTitle: Trusted companies and Iran's terminals in one place
trust.companiesText: From Volvo to Scania and MAN; from VIP and reclining seats to single and regular seats: all of them are here for you to book and buy online.
trust.discountsText: With Rahi you can compare the prices and discounts of the bus companies, and easily choose and book cheap, good-quality tickets at the times and on the routes you want.
trust.buyingText: Rahi lets you book and buy bus tickets online on the website, with no need to sign up.

findTicket.title: Find a ticket
findTicket.intro: Open a ticket you bought on Rahi with its ticket code and your mobile number.
findTicket.aboutText: Rahi has no accounts, so a ticket is opened with two things together: the 12-digit ticket code shown on the “Your ticket is issued” page after you pay, and the mobile number you entered when buying. Both must match. With them you can see the trip, the passengers and the seats again at any time.
findTicket.noteKeepCode: Rahi does not send the ticket code by text message or email. Write it down, or keep the ticket page open.
findTicket.noteHold: A seat on hold that is not paid for within 10 minutes is released, and the page of that ticket then says the ticket was not issued.
findTicket.noteCancel: A paid ticket cannot be cancelled on the website yet.
findTicket.noteDemo: Rahi is a practice project with a demo payment page: no money moves and no real seat is booked.
findTicket.notFoundQuestion: Why is my ticket not found?
findTicket.notFoundAnswer: A ticket opens only when the ticket code and the mobile number both match the purchase. Check that the code has all 12 digits, and that the number is the one typed on the passenger details form, starting with 09. For privacy, the website does not say which of the two is wrong.
findTicket.phoneQuestion: Which mobile number do I enter?
findTicket.phoneAnswer: The one typed in the “Mobile number” box of the “Passenger details” step when the ticket was bought. It is the buyer's number, even if the ticket is for other passengers. Any other number will not open the ticket, even if it is yours.
findTicket.codeQuestion: Where do I find my ticket code?
findTicket.codeAnswer: It is shown on the “Your ticket is issued” page right after the payment, under “Ticket code”, and it is also the last part of that page's address. Rahi sends no text message or email, so a lost code cannot be recovered.
findTicket.holdQuestion: What happens to a seat I held but did not pay for?
findTicket.holdAnswer: Seats are held for 10 minutes from the moment the passenger details are sent. While that time is running, the ticket code opens the “Review and pay” page so you can finish paying. If the payment is not made in time, the seats are released for other buyers and you are not charged. After that, the same code opens a page saying the ticket was not issued; to travel, search again and make a new purchase.
